title: The Market Crashed 3 Times in 5 Years. Each Time the VIX Futures Curve Warned You First.
description:
The CAPE ratio is sitting near all time highs and Mag Seven earnings week just kicked off options trading math has a framework for exactly this moment, and most traders aren't using it. Math Check runs the vol futures curve, the CAPE ratio, and SPX probability analysis all in one episode.

If you want to know what the options market is actually pricing for a real crash versus a routine pullback, the vol futures contango versus backwardation distinction is the only signal worth tracking right now.
